claim: ComfyUI is a modular AI engine for content creation.

The primary interface is a visual node graph for building image, video, audio, 3D and text workflows; execution is local with asynchronous queueing, partial graph re-execution, VRAM/RAM management, model offloading and quantized model support.
Most fixes should touch the narrowest code path that explains the bug, performance issue, dtype issue, model-format issue, or user-facing behavior.

Core ComfyUI must not make requests to the internet; uploads, telemetry, analytics, tracking, update checks, remote config, feature flags and any opt-in or user-triggered outbound path are all refused in core.
No torch.no_grad, torch.inference_mode or inference-mode helper wrappers may be added; the only allowed use is disabling a globally set inference mode when a training path needs gradients.
ComfyUI models are always treated as frozen for inference, so freeze/unfreeze/trainability toggles must not be added to model classes.
Model detection code that inspects linear weight shapes must use only the first dimension; the second dimension may be half the original size for NVFP4 or other 4-bit quantized models.
Model-native latent layout handling stays inside the model or latent-format owner; nodes and caller-side adapters must not collapse, expand, pack or unpack latent dimensions.
An autonomous run takes only LOOP.md as its instruction; one run equals one improvement, and a decision not to execute is written as an interruption report.

Work candidates are selected in fixed order: make test failures first, then source TODO/FIXME, then docs-vs-implementation mismatch; every run is verified with make test and must not commit while existing tests are broken.
Autonomous runs must not push, force-push, rewrite history, operate tags or releases, or deploy; violations count as run failure.
A DynamicPrompt expands into a graph that ExecutionList executes in topological order, with cycle detection (DependencyCycleError) and per-node input errors (NodeInputError).
load_models_gpu is the central entry that decides load, partial load, or offload per model based on VRAMState and memory estimation; LoadedModel wraps the loaded state.
LatentFormat is the base class owning native latent layout, with per-family subclasses including SD15, SDXL, SD3, Flux, and Flux2.

quant_ops exposes optimized weight layouts (_CKFp8Layout-backed) including TensorCoreMXFP8Layout, TensorCoreNVFP4Layout, and TensorCore FP8 E4M3/E5M2 layouts; invalid quantization metadata must fail with a clear error instead of silently degrading output.
Woodpecker runs Ruff and tests-unit on PRs and pushes to main; GitHub Actions is disabled in this fork and remaining upstream workflows do not execute.
This fork does not automatically track Comfy-Org/ComfyUI; upstream merges happen only on explicit owner instruction.
The comfy.ops.cast_to alias was removed; the canonical at-use cast helper is comfy.model_management.cast_to, and comfy.ops.cast_to_input delegates to it.

Model implementations that cast raw parameters at use (comfy.clip_model, comfy.ldm.moge.modules, comfy.ldm.trellis2.vae, comfy.ldm.genmo.joint_model.asymm_models_joint) call comfy.model_management.cast_to directly.
